QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Heaven Empire
QuestInfo.0: Rumor has it that an envoy from the Heaven Empire is on his way. Maybe Leon will tell you what that means...
QuestInfo.1: Rumor has it that an envoy from the Heaven Empire is on his way. Leon gave you a little rundown of why that was important.
QuestInfo.2: Leon told you that the #rHeaven Empire#k is the most powerful nation that Commerci has dealings with, and that an envoy in Commerci can only mean trouble.

0.0: Okay, I've had some time to think my thoughts...

yes.0: The Heaven Empire first made contact with Commerci in way ancient days, when we were still just a poor fishing village. Well, not me personally, because I wasn't born. But they had all the power, so naturally they've been pushing us around for centuries.
yes.1: They think that Commerci is just some asset they can control. They've despised us for years, and the feeling is mutual.
yes.2: But they're paying attention now. We've got as much money as they do, and they're scared we're going to take their tile. Commerci's turning into a problem.

1.0: My dad's been all stressed out about it for months now. He's been trying to open trade with Danbar, their capital, but they just won't say yes.

yes.0: Now they're sending some high-ranking hot shot over to give us terms? It's bad, you know?
